style: Authentic live-action 35mm film still, Kodak Portra 400 colors, quiet late-autumn mood, soft natural window light, gentle film grain, realistic skin texture with fine wrinkles, natural restrained expressions.

frames.name: pb_a
frames.prompt: Early morning in a lived-in farmhouse-style kitchen in late autumn, soft cool window daylight. By the half-glazed back door (bottom right of the frame) sits a worn, empty, round oatmeal-colored dog bed with a flattened cushion; on the cushion lies a faded red fabric dog collar with a small round silver tag (the same collar as the dog in the attached photo, but NO dog anywhere in the image). Above the dog bed is a bare, plain warm-white painted wall section. A woman, 62 (white American, chin-length silver-blonde hair, reading glasses on a beaded chain, an oatmeal cardigan over a soft blue shirt), stands at the kitchen counter on the left holding a steaming mug in both hands, turned toward the empty dog bed, looking at it quietly with a small, sad smile. Medium-wide shot from standing chest height, she is visible from the knees up, the dog bed and the bare wall above it clearly visible on the right. Wooden counter, a few apples in a bowl, a kettle.

frames.name: pb_b
frames.prompt: NEW SHOT, same woman (same silver-blonde hair, reading glasses, oatmeal cardigan) that evening, sitting curled up on a soft grey sofa under a warm table lamp, a knit throw over her knees, holding her phone in both hands at chest height and scrolling through old photos (screen faces her, NOT visible to camera). She pauses on one photo, a slow tender smile forming, her thumb resting on the screen, eyes glistening. Medium shot from seated eye level, waist up. Warm lamp light, dark window behind. Ignore the kitchen of the reference; only keep her identity.

frames.name: pb_c
frames.prompt: NEW SHOT, same kitchen, same back door, mid-morning. Straight-on medium-wide shot of the plain warm-white wall above the empty dog bed. On the wall, centered horizontally, hangs a simple light natural-oak picture frame with a wide white mat, PORTRAIT orientation (taller than wide), perfectly straight-on and parallel to the camera (no perspective tilt), the frame width about 34% of the image width, its center at about 36% of the image height. The area inside the white mat is a completely blank, flat, evenly lit pale cream paper: leave it EMPTY, no artwork, no picture. Directly below the frame on the floor: the worn oatmeal dog bed with the faded red collar on its cushion. The woman (same silver-blonde hair, oatmeal cardigan) stands on the left side of the frame, one step back from the wall, in three-quarter profile, one hand pressed flat on her chest, looking up at the frame with a soft teary smile. She does not cover the frame.

frames.name: pb_d
frames.prompt: Change only: the woman has left; nobody in the image. Same wall, same picture frame (position and size unchanged, inside still a blank pale cream paper), same empty dog bed with the faded red collar below it. A beam of warm morning sun now falls across the wall and the dog bed.
